verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents attaching custom metadata (user IDs, session IDs, feature tags) to LLM calls so that cost and usage can be broken down along those dimensions. The nearby items cover other capabilities: evaluations linked to sessions, org-level agent cost monitoring in Agent Console, and a generic custom search dimension. None of them is cost attribution via custom metadata, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata
